DSC 6400: Data Ethics
Fall 2026 Syllabus
Instructor: Dr. Ana Patel

Course Description
This course examines ethical questions raised by the collection and use of data.

Late Work Policy
Assignments submitted late lose 10% per day. Discussion posts are not accepted more than three days late.

Academic Integrity
All work must be your own. Papers are checked with Turnitin. Plagiarism results in a zero for the assignment.

Use of Artificial Intelligence
You may use AI tools to brainstorm, but all submitted writing must be your own and AI use must be disclosed.

Writing Standards
All papers follow APA 7th edition: Times New Roman 12, double-spaced, with a title page and references.

Discussion Expectations
Initial posts are at least 250 words with one scholarly source. Reply to at least two classmates.

Grading Scale
A 90-100, B 80-89, C 70-79.
